Anthropic can already retrain Mythos with "a fraction of the compute originally needed," says former researcher Coxon
Jacob Coxon, former OpenAI and Anthropic researcher who brought AI fears into the mainstream, says a slide from Anthropic's IPO roadshow was a major reason he quit.
Coxon says a slide Anthropic released for its IPO roadshow was a key reason he left the company after only about four months. The chart shows how much compute Anthropic needs over time to train its models, and the axis is compressed so that a 10x and a 100x increase barely look different.
Yet the curve still climbs steeply, which Coxon says shows that algorithmic efficiency is improving not just quickly but at an accelerating rate. "It's an insane plot and I'm surprised they made it public," he writes.
Coxon argues that Anthropic's Mythos model, a major capability jump in the spring, was part of this accelerating trend. "Mythos was not a one-time deviation, but a point on a superexponential. They could already retrain Mythos with a fraction of the compute originally needed," he writes.
He says algorithmic improvements are "on the verge of being automated," which is why he wants frontier model development paused next year so competitors can catch up. A pause, he writes, would "commoditize human-level intelligence. It would only harm OpenAI and Anthropic."
Coxon previously trained AI models at OpenAI and, most recently, Anthropic. He drew wide attention in September with public warnings about the risks of advanced AI systems, echoed by other protagonists in the industry. One of their fears is that advanced, self-improving AI could get out of control.

digest_he:
ג'ייקוב קוקסון, חוקר לשעבר ב-OpenAI וב-Anthropic, חשף כי שקופיות ממצגת של חברת Anthropic לקראת הנפקה היו בין הסיבות המרכזיות לעזיבתו את החברה. לדבריו, נתונים אלו מוכיחים כי היעילות האלגוריתמית של מודלי הבינה המלאכותית משתפרת לא רק במהירות, אלא בקצב מואץ ומעריכי.

קוקסון ציין כי מודל Mythos של החברה מהווה נקודה בתוך מגמה זו, וכי החברה מסוגלת כיום לאמן אותו מחדש תוך שימוש בשבריר בלבד מכוח החישוב שנדרש במקור. בעקבות זאת, הוא קורא לעצור בשנה הבאה את פיתוחם של מודלי החזית כדי לאפשר למתחרים לסגור את הפער ולהפוך את הבינה המלאכותית ברמת האדם למוצר נגיש.
